summary_markdown:
The team coordinated the release of a beta campaign model and data to production. Initial discussions covered two deployment options (releasing the campaign first vs. releasing data first), with the decision made to proceed with the full deployment.

Several technical issues were addressed, including fixing historical data ranges (extended back to May 1st) and resolving performance issues related to the traffic dashboard loading large datasets. It was also decided to temporarily remove 'dwell-time' from reports.

Finally, user access roles for multiple individuals were managed and updated to ensure they all had 'Publisher' status for the campaign. The version number (2023.8.1) was confirmed as part of the successful release.
decisions: The beta campaign model and data were deployed to production.
Historical reporting data range was extended back to May 1st.
Dwell-time metric will be temporarily removed from reports.
User roles for multiple individuals were standardized to 'Publisher'.
